summary: PHASE 7 testing complete: Weather layers panel with Nuages (NASA GIBS MODIS Terra) and Pluie (RainViewer) toggles, animation controls, and responsive layout fix for screens < 1024px. All features working correctly.

issues: 'Zoom Level Not Supported' message appears at high zoom levels - this is expected behavior from NASA GIBS tile provider when zoom exceeds maxNativeZoom (level 9 for MODIS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 7 FEATURES TESTED: 1) Weather layers panel (data-testid='weather-layers-panel') exists at bottom-right of map. 2) 'Nuages' toggle (data-testid='toggle-clouds') activates NASA GIBS MODIS Terra satellite imagery layer. 3) 'Pluie' toggle (data-testid='toggle-rain') activates RainViewer radar precipitation layer. 4) Toggles are mutually exclusive - clicking one deactivates the other. 5) Animation controls appear when layer active: play/pause button (data-testid='play-pause-frames') and range slider (data-testid='frame-slider'). 6) Source credit row shows 'Source · NASA MODIS Terra' or 'Source · RainViewer' based on active layer. 7) Desktop viewport (1920x1080): Map visible at right of sidebar with width 1280px. 8) Mobile viewport (800x900): Map at top with h-[60vh] (540px), sidebar below. 9) NASA GIBS tiles load from gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg3857/best/MODIS_Terra_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor/. 10) RainViewer tiles load from tilecache.rainviewer.com/v2/radar/. 11) Animation plays through last 5 days for clouds, last 2h for rain. 12) Slider interaction changes displayed frame.
